title: 프로젝트 발표
scene: 회사 첫 발표. 노트북이 꺼지고, 마이크가 울리고, 대표님이 들어온다
goal: A presentation where everything goes wrong

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: {name} 씨, 준비 다 됐죠? 바로 시작할게요.
turns.rd: {name} ssi, junbi da dwaetjyo? baro sijakalgeyo.
turns.en: {name}, you're all set, right? Let's just get started.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 네. 안녕하십니까. 오늘 제가 말씀드릴 건 회의를 좀 더 짧게 하자는 내용인데요…
turns.rd: ne. annyeonghasimnikka. oneul jega malsseumdeuril geon hoeuireul jom deo jjalge hajaneun naeyongindeyo…
turns.en: Yes. Hello. Today I'll be talking about making our meetings a bit shorter…

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Huh? The screen just went black. Just a second…

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: (속삭이며) 배터리야! 충전기 어디 갔어? 빨리 찾아!
turns.rd: (soksagimyeo) baeteoriya! chungjeongi eodi gasseo? ppalli chaja!
turns.en: (whispering) It's the battery! Where's the charger? Find it quick!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I'm sorry… (feedback squeal—) Ah, how do I turn this off?

turns.speaker: D
turns.ko: 마이크 좀 꺼 주세요! 소리 너무 커요, 진짜!
turns.rd: maikeu jom kkeo juseyo! sori neomu keoyo, jinjja!
turns.en: Please turn the mic off! It's way too loud, seriously!

turns.speaker: E
turns.ko: (문 열리며) 아, 지금 발표 중이셨군요? 대표입니다. 저도 잠깐 들어볼게요.
turns.rd: (mun yeollimyeo) a, jigeum balpyo jungisyeotgunyo? daepyoimnida. jeodo jamkkan deureobolgeyo.
turns.en: (door opens) Oh, you're in the middle of presenting? I'm the CEO. I'll listen for a bit too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 네… 그럼 화면 없이 그냥 말씀드릴게요.
turns.rd: ne… geureom hwamyeon eopsi geunyang malsseumdeurilgeyo.
turns.en: Yes… Then I'll just explain without the screen.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 제가 드리고 싶은 말씀은 하나예요. 회의는 진짜 5분만 하자고요.
turns.rd: jega deurigo sipeun malsseumeun hanayeyo. hoeuineun jinjja 5bunman hajagoyo.
turns.en: What I want to say is one thing. Let's keep meetings to really just five minutes.

turns.speaker: E
turns.en: (smiling) Nice. This presentation just now was almost five minutes too, right?

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 네, 노트북이 딱 도와준 것 같아요.
turns.rd: ne, noteubugi ttak dowajun geot gatayo.
turns.en: Yes, the laptop seemed to help just right.

turns.speaker: E
turns.ko: 다음 주부터 그렇게 해봅시다. 팀장님, 김치찌개는 계속 드셔도 괜찮아요.
turns.rd: daeum jubuteo geureoke haebopsida. timjangnim, gimchijjigaeneun gyesok deusyeodo gwaenchanayo.
turns.en: Let's do that starting next week. Team leader, you can keep having your kimchi stew.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: (whispering) This presentation is gonna be a total legend.
